title: The cart's store stops: cart calls fail, checkouts fail two calls up
question: default 클러스터 otel-demo 네임스페이스 쇼핑몰에서 결제가 안 된대. 원인이 뭐야?
question_vague: default 클러스터 otel-demo 네임스페이스 쇼핑몰이 이상하다는데 원인 찾아줘.
wait: kubectl -n otel-demo wait --for=condition=Available deploy/frontend-proxy deploy/frontend deploy/checkout deploy/cart deploy/valkey-cart deploy/payment deploy/load-generator --timeout=10s && kubectl -n $NS wait --for=condition=Available deploy/uptime-check --timeout=10s
inject_wait: kubectl -n $NS logs deploy/uptime-check --since=40s | grep 'check failed' | grep -q 'path=/api/cart'

annotations.summary: Placing an order fails in the otel-demo shop
annotations.description: uptime-check, which watches the shop in otel-demo through frontend-proxy, has seen requests fail for the last few minutes, and the shop's checkouts fail.
